correctness.rationale: For connected symmetric conductance network N>=3, first-step grounded Laplacian yields total ordered pair MFPT M(0)=T0 tr(G)/(N-1), where T0=2 sum_e g_e t_e, G=L^dagger. A single new edge of conductance w yields L+wbb^T and time loading T0+2tw; Sherman–Morrison gives G_w=G-[w/(1+wR)]Gbb^TG, hence M(w)=(T0+2tw)(A+Bw)/[(N-1)(1+Rw)]. Since G>0 on 1^perp dimension N-1>=2, A,R,Q>0 and B=AR-Q>0. Difference has numerator w(2tA-T0Q+2tBw), derivative has monotone polynomial 2tA-T0Q+4tBw+2tRBw², proving strict all-harm threshold t>=T0Q/(2A) or unique w* and wreturn in improving phase. Fresh symbolic four-cycle calculation gives A=5/4,R=1,Q=1/2,B=3/4,T0=8,t*=8/5, and t=1 leads derivative numerator proportional to w²+2w-1 with unique optimum sqrt(2)-1. The pinned independent grounded-Laplacian checker confirms finite graphs but is not the all-network proof.

originality.rationale: General transport MFPT spectral objective is established by Gounaris–Katifori; rank-one Laplacian trace updates are established by Predari et al. Their combination is credited and algebraically implies an explicit rational function, but the exact fixed-old-edge single-channel monotone derivative, sharp cost threshold, finite unique optimizer and return point are not stated in inspected full papers. A Resultary Kemeny biclique weighted-link optimization addresses stationary-target Kemeny constant, not uniform ordered-pair MFPT with edge traversal times. Originality is the sharp universal one-link classification, not either input identity.
residual_risks: An unindexed specialization of the known graph-pseudoinverse and global hitting-time identities could predate this sharp universal single-edge phase classification.

value.rationale: The sign of a physical shortcut's effect competes between shorter electrical resistance and increased traversal loading, so a universal N>=3 classification of when it helps, the only optimum, and exact benefit interval is useful independently of any paper-sized global design result. It rules out delayed benefits for all connected weighted graph topologies; the restriction against changing old weights/budget is mathematically essential.
